# Understood

> > Understood empowers families, educators, and workplaces to support the 70 million people with learning and thinking differences like ADHD and dyslexia.

Understood provides evidence-based resources, tools, and training to help parents identify learning differences through Take N.O.T.E., support educators in inclusive teaching, and enable workplace neuroinclusion. Content is available in English and Spanish, with partnerships including the American Academy of Pediatrics and UnidosUS.

## Key Topics

- Take N.O.T.E. (Notice, Observe, Talk, Engage)
- Learning differences and neurodiversity
- ADHD (TDAH) and dyslexia (dislexia)
- IEP (Individualized Education Program)
- Parent-teacher-pediatrician collaboration
- Behavior tracking and child development
- Workplace neuroinclusion
- American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) partnership
- Spanish-language resources
- Educator support and training
- Parent communication strategies
- UnidosUS Latino family outreach
- Pediatrician consultation tools
- Through My Eyes podcast series

## Take N.O.T.E. Core Tools

- [Take N.O.T.E. for Parents](https://www.understood.org/en/take-note): Main parent tool for spotting learning and thinking differences in children
- [Take N.O.T.E. para Padres (Spanish)](https://www.understood.org/es-mx/take-note): Spanish version of the parent tool for detecting learning and behavior issues
- [Take N.O.T.E. for Educators](https://www.understood.org/en/take-note/educators): Educator version to support families and students with learning differences
- [Take N.O.T.E. para Educadores (Spanish)](https://www.understood.org/es-mx/take-note/educators): Spanish educator tool for parent-teacher collaboration

## Take N.O.T.E. Framework Steps

- [Notice - Observing Behavioral Signs](https://www.understood.org/es-mx/take-note/notice): First step: identifying signs of learning differences in children (Spanish)
- [Observe - Behavior Tracking](https://www.understood.org/en/take-note/observe): Second step: tracking patterns and documenting observations
- [Observe - Seguimiento (Spanish)](https://www.understood.org/es-mx/take-note/observe): Spanish guide for child behavior tracking and pattern recognition
- [Talk - Communication Guide](https://www.understood.org/en/take-note/talk): Third step: effective parent-teacher-pediatrician conversations
- [Talk - Conversación (Spanish)](https://www.understood.org/es-mx/take-note/talk): Spanish guide for collaborative discussions with educators and doctors
- [Engage - Expert Connections](https://www.understood.org/es-mx/take-note/engage): Fourth step: connecting with specialists to support child strengths (Spanish)

## Partnership Programs

- [Take N.O.T.E. for Pediatricians (AAP)](https://www.understood.org/en/take-note/partners/aap): American Academy of Pediatrics partnership resources for doctors
- [Take N.O.T.E. para Pediatras (AAP Spanish)](https://www.understood.org/es-mx/take-note/partners/aap): Spanish resources for pediatricians in collaboration with AAP
- [Take N.O.T.E. for Unidos (Latino Families)](https://www.understood.org/en/take-note/partners/unidos): UnidosUS partnership guide for supporting Latino families
- [Partner with Understood](https://www.understood.org/en/our-partners): Partnership opportunities to empower 70M people with learning differences
- [Asociarse con Understood (Spanish)](https://www.understood.org/es-mx/our-partners): Spanish partnership page for neurodiversity support collaboration

## Workplace Neuroinclusion

- [Workplace Resources](https://www.understood.org/en/workplace): Training and resources for creating inclusive workplaces for employees with ADHD, dyslexia, and other learning differences

## Media and Podcasts

- [Podcasts](https://www.understood.org/en/podcasts): Audio content on ADHD, neurodiversity, parenting, and workplace inclusion
- [Podcasts (Spanish)](https://www.understood.org/es-mx/podcasts): Spanish-language podcasts covering learning differences, IEP, and neurodiversity
